scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic proof and reproducible standard-library arithmetic; finite simulations are supportive, not a substitute for the unrestricted argument. Possible unindexed equivalents remain a scholarly risk.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for simple labelled wheels, three colors, synchronous threshold-one cyclic cellular automata only; transfer recurrences require stated definitions, and no stronger graph-general enumeration is claimed.
title: Six-class orbit and transient census for the three-color cyclic automaton on wheels
